title: Does memory help? Measured on the intern's own mistakes, the gate sized before it was frozen
request: The owner: keep the intern's memory brief on; build a v2 test that picks cases from Claude's own mistakes, with the gate sized before it is frozen; each run capped at one euro.
spec: MEMORY_PLAN.md 35.8 v2: a memory-off pilot chooses the treated cases; a simulation sizes the repeats; the plan is frozen once; paired sessions on against off; stored with intervals.
plan: Pre-screen candidate columns with the rules, free
Write the pool, the pilot, the selection and the sizing rules in a manifest
Test first with a scripted model
Commit the rules, run the pilot, freeze and commit the plan
Run the main comparison in chunks of one euro

decisions.decision: Choose the treated cases in a memory-off pilot
decisions.why: v1 chose them from another model's mistakes, so only 3 of 8 could move

decisions.decision: Shrink pilot rates toward the pool's own rate
decisions.why: cases chosen for being wrong look worse in the pilot than they are

decisions.decision: Refuse to start a run that cannot reach its gate
decisions.why: spending on a test that cannot pass teaches nothing

decisions.decision: Commit the rules before the pilot and the frozen plan before the main run
decisions.why: a commit time proves the choice did not follow the result

decisions.decision: Plant real leaks beside two corrected columns
decisions.why: memory must not make the intern keep everything

change: dclab_rnd/agent_eval/memory_value_v2.py; memory_value.py helpers take an explicit manifest; evidence/campaigns/memory_value_v2 (manifest, frozen, MV2-001); tests/test_memory_value_v2.py; MEMORY_PLAN.md status.

findings.defect: The rules could change after the pilot was seen
findings.scenario: only four cases qualify; a person lowers the minimum and freezes; the run starts
findings.cause: freeze recorded the manifest as it was at freeze time, never the pilot's
findings.fix: freeze reads the pilot's run record and refuses another manifest; the frozen plan keeps the pilot's model, prompts and code; the main run refuses any change

findings.defect: The verdict read whatever the frozen plan said at the end
findings.scenario: a case that went badly is removed from the plan after the run; the verdict improves
findings.cause: summarize never compared the run's record with the frozen plan
findings.fix: summarize refuses unless the run's campaign, frozen plan and manifest all match; pilot sessions are named P- so they never count as main sessions

findings.defect: Sizing was too hopeful when true mistake rates were moderate
findings.scenario: a pool with rates near one half: the predicted power was high, the true power low
findings.cause: rates were pulled toward one half, not toward the pool
findings.fix: rates are pulled toward the pool's own pilot rate with a fixed strength in the manifest

findings.defect: The leak check was pooled, so one case's loss was hidden
findings.scenario: memory makes the intern keep a planted leak in one of three sessions of one case; the pooled share still passes
findings.cause: every case with a leak was mixed into one share
findings.fix: a new check reads each treated case that holds a leak on its own

findings.defect: Stored sessions carried the wrong role
findings.scenario: a control or pilot session was saved as treated
findings.cause: the scenario passed to the session had no role
findings.fix: each session is stored with its true role: candidate, treated or control

findings.defect: A case could be chosen for a mistake its correction does not cover
findings.scenario: a pilot session drops a base column; the case is chosen anyway
findings.cause: selection counted any column judged against memory
findings.fix: selection counts a session only when the corrected column itself was the mistake

findings.defect: More than one pilot could be run and the best one frozen
findings.scenario: two pilot folders under other names; the better one is frozen
findings.cause: the check looked only at folder names
findings.fix: freeze refuses when any other folder's run record says it is a pilot with sessions

findings.defect: The main run did not check the intern's code against the pilot's
findings.scenario: the intern loop or the scoring changes between pilot and main run; the run starts anyway
findings.cause: only model, thinking and prompts were compared
findings.fix: the main run also refuses a change in the intern's loop, memory reading and writing, and scoring code

findings.defect: Two of three was not counted as two thirds
findings.scenario: a case wrong in 2 of 3 pilot sessions was not chosen
findings.fix: selection compares whole counts: wrong times 3 at least 2 times scored

findings.defect: The workspace monthly cap stopped the main run part way
findings.scenario: 33 sessions stopped at once with no spend
findings.cause: the workspace's shared monthly model budget was reached by all sessions together
findings.fix: the owner raised the cap; the stopped sessions reran as later attempts, the first attempts kept whole

measurements.name: pilot: corrected column judged against memory, memory off
measurements.gate: a case is treated when wrong in at least 2 of 3 scored pilot sessions
measurements.result: 12 of 17 candidates wrong in every pilot session; 10 taken by the rule
measurements.against_gate: 10 cases chosen, the simulated power at three repeats reached the bar
limits: the pilot only chooses cases; it never enters the verdict

measurements.name: main run: against_memory on treated cases, on minus off
measurements.gate: mean at most -0.15 and exact sign-flip p below 0.05 over the case means
measurements.result: with memory 0 of 30 sessions repeated a corrected mistake, without memory 29 of 30; mean -0.967, sign-flip p 0.00098, bootstrap [-1.0, -0.9]
measurements.against_gate: every guard held: leaks kept on controls and on each treated case with a leak, no new false alarms, solutions saved, tokens lower with memory
limits: the effect is memory's on mistakes this model makes, not an average over every column
the earlier session is scripted; the tables are invented; the sealed read waits for the owner

outcome: Memory helps on dev: the intern stopped repeating every corrected mistake that it made without memory, kept every planted leak, and used fewer input tokens. The gate was met; the brief stays on.
lessons: Choose the treated cases from the measured model's own mistakes, in a pilot that never enters the verdict.
Check that a gate can be passed before freezing it; refuse to spend on one that cannot.
Commit the rules before the pilot and the plan before the main run, so the choice cannot follow the result.
A shared monthly cap can stop a run part way; resumable sessions with kept attempts make that harmless.
risks: Cases are near copies of a few kinds of mistake; a sealed read needs new kinds of case.
Memory might help less when a real person's earlier note is vaguer than the scripted one.
